nary_nodes.label: UIBC Award Ceremony
evidence: The International Union of Bakers and Confectioners (UIBC) named him World Confectioner of the Year last month.

Three years after fellow French pastry chef Nina Métayer was crowned champion, Castel received the UIBC award presented annually to a leading figure in the profession in recognition of their career and contribution to the trade on July 14 in Singapore.

nary_nodes.label: New Recipe Testing
evidence: The smell of warm bread hangs in the air at one of Benoît Castel's patisseries in Paris, where the newly crowned world's best pastry chef was hard at work testing new recipes.
Dressed in his white pastry chef's jacket embroidered with his name, he works with Romain Montbabut, his head baker, with whom he regularly tests new recipes.

nary_nodes.label: Best-Selling Pastry
evidence: The pastry shop's glass cases are arrayed with blueberry and raspberry tartlets, cherry clafoutis and vanilla flans, but his best-seller is a chocolate choux pastry.
If we stopped making it, there'd be protests,

nary_nodes.label: Mission Statement
evidence: I have a mission: to be the world champion every day in my shop for my customers,

nary_nodes.label: New Venue Opening
evidence: Alongside his daughter Margot, he is set to open a new venue in Paris in September – a cross between a café, a restaurant and a bakery-patisserie.
